name: habblaud
description: Plugins of Habblaud, the pixel-art virtual office of your Claude Code sessions.

plugins.name: habblaud
plugins.description: The Habblaud mod: plan usage (5-hour and weekly) for the office, a notice under the prompt when another session needs you, and the /habblaud command.

plugins.name: habblaud-permissoes
plugins.description: Approve or deny Claude Code permission requests from Habblaud and answer the agent's questions (PermissionRequest hook).

plugins.name: habblaud-mensagens
plugins.description: Send messages from Habblaud: what you type in the office enters the session as if you had typed it in the terminal.

plugins.name: habblaud-remote
plugins.description: Send this machine's Claude Code sessions to a central Habblaud on another machine (asynchronous hooks; needs HABBLAUD_SERVER_URL and HABBLAUD_SERVER_TOKEN).
